scoring_justification: Recompute spectral moments from agent's delta-peak parameters and compare to fixed exact gold; recompute condition_holds from energies.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold exact moments and peak parameters for the highly localized limit and large-radius limit
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from paper equations (8a-e), (30), (33), (A2), (A7) with parameters I=1, S=1, <Sz>=0.5, normalized envelope and full spin alignment at T=0.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Exact analytic evaluation of paper formulas; verified against reference solve.sh oracle.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are exact analytic results from the paper's own derivation; no external data needed.

output_contract.notes: The checker independently recomputes the exact moments and energies from the paper's formulas and compares each numerical value within an appropriate tolerance.
